description: One run with its per-test result rows, across every shard - one row per Playwright project variant, like Playwright: a test that ran in chromium and firefox is two rows, each named with its project ("chromium > cart.spec.ts > adds"). Use this to find out which test is red in a run; the run list carries only the counters. Its status is cancelled for a cancelled run (cancellation says how and when), and local says it ran without CI. Like squally-find-run it carries settled, jobKey, attempt, rerunOf and ciRunUrl - for a re-run, rerunOf.id is the run it re-ran, to compare with. Each test row is the test's final attempt: a test that passed only after a retry has status passed and attempts above 1, and the errors of its failed attempts come only from squally-debug-failure.

runId.description: A run id from GET /projects/{projectId}/runs - or any shard's id of a sharded run.

name: squally-get-run

flaky.description: Tests whose final attempt passed after at least one retry in this run. Not counted in passed: total = passed + failed + skipped + flaky.

total.description: Tests in the run, every test once however many shards reported it - its final attempt across all of them decides (highest retry, then the lowest shard, then the first repetition). total = passed + failed + skipped + flaky. Since 1.0.0-beta.12; until then each shard's count was summed, so a test reported from two shards counted twice. In a cancelled run the tests the cancel interrupted - reported as skipped - count nowhere, so skipped there counts no test (since 1.0.0-beta.13); the run's tests list still has them.

attempt.description: Which attempt of its CI run this is - GitHub Actions' run attempt, 2 after Re-run failed jobs. null when the reporter did not say and the run id did not show it. Since 1.0.0-beta.15.

at.description: When the run was cancelled. For a sharded run, the first shard to record it - or, when the cancel marked the whole run before any shard recorded one (shards that had not begun, since 2026-10-22), when it was marked.

byUserId.description: The user who cancelled the run, when source is "user"; null otherwise.

source.description: Where the cancel came from: "reporter" (Playwright was interrupted - a cancelled CI job, a Ctrl-C - and the reporter said so), "cli" or "user" (the dashboard). A plain string, not a closed set: new sources may be added. null only for a cancel recorded without a source, which Squally never writes.

cancellation.description: How and when the run was cancelled; null when it was not - set exactly when status is cancelled.

ciRunUrl.description: The CI run's page - the run page's View in CI link: the URL the reporter sent (squally-reporter 0.11.0; GitHub Actions links the attempt), else for GitHub Actions one built from the project's linked repository when it has exactly one. https only; null when neither applies. Since 1.0.0-beta.15.

commitSha.description: The commit the run is reported under: the pushed commit, or for a pull request its head commit. The commit the GitHub check and the commit links use.

finishedAt.description: When the run finished - for a sharded run, its latest shard. null while it is still running. A cancelled run has finished: it ends at the latest shard that reported, even when a shard stopped by the same cancel never did.

jobKey.description: The job key the reporter sent (SQUALLY_CI_JOB_KEY, squally-reporter 0.11.0): which job of a CI run this is, for example the browser of a matrix. Each job is its own run with its own GitHub check, <check name> · <key>: the check name of the linked repository, "Squally" for the first project that links a repository. null when the job set none. Since 1.0.0-beta.15.

local.description: No shard of the run reported a CI provider: a local run (since 1.0.0-beta.14). GET /runs lists both kinds unless source says otherwise.

id.description: The earlier attempt's id - the one GET /runs/{runId} takes.

rerunOf.description: The run this one re-ran: the latest earlier attempt of the same CI run (and job key) that reported to Squally. null for a first attempt, when the earlier attempt never reported, or once retention deleted it. Since 1.0.0-beta.15.

settled.description: Whether the run is settled: its status and counts are final and it counts in the dashboard's figures. false while a shard is running, and while the run still waits for a shard within the run time limit, counted from its shards' last activity - once that passes, the hourly check settles it as incomplete. The dashboard's unfinished runs are the ones not settled. Since 1.0.0-beta.15.

expected.description: How many shards the run waits for: the shard total the CI run declared - for a re-run, the shards it re-ran (those that had not passed before it; the others are not run again and do not report). null when no shard declared a total. The run is complete when every expected shard has completed.

status.description: What this shard did, in the run status's words: cancelled when it recorded a cancel; else running or incomplete by its state; else failed when a test failed, passed otherwise. The shards panel's own rule (since 1.0.0-beta.14 - it was the shard's raw outcome, null until it finished).

How the run ended, the dashboard's own word: cancelled - the run was cancelled (for a sharded run, any shard recorded a cancel, or Squally marked the whole run cancelled; cancellation says how and when); incomplete - a shard timed out, was stopped by the monthly result limit, or never reported by the time the run is overdue by the project's run timeout, counted from its shards' last activity (a begin, a batch of results or a completion; their latest start until 2026-10-27); running - a shard is still running, or the run still waits for a shard within that time; failed - every shard finished and a test failed; passed - every shard finished and none failed. In that order: the first that applies. Since 1.0.0-beta.14 - before it, a cancelled run reported the outcome beneath the cancel and a cancelled boolean. Waiting for a shard is running since 2026-10-20 - before it, incomplete.

testedRevision.description: The application revision the run was told it tested - opt-in, null unless the CI job sets it: TESTED_REVISION=<revision>, or SAME_REPO_AS_APP=true for the commit CI built (on a pull request, the merge commit). Never the pull request's head - that is commitSha.

annotations.description: The final attempt's annotation types (Playwright's test.info().annotations), in the order they were added - types only; descriptions are on the attempts endpoint. Empty when there are none, and for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

attempts.description: Every attempt of the test in the run, across all its shards (since 1.0.0-beta.12; per shard before).

location.description: Where the test is declared in its file (Playwright's TestCase.location) - the file is filePath. null for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

shard.description: The shard the test's final attempt ran in; null for an unsharded run. One row per test since 1.0.0-beta.12 - a test reported from two shards was one row per shard before.

timedOut.description: The final attempt's. Whether the attempt ended by running into its time limit (Playwright's timedOut). null when the reporter did not say - every result from a reporter before 0.10.0.

timeoutMs.description: The final attempt's. The time limit Playwright applied to the attempt, in milliseconds; 0 means no limit. null when the reporter did not say.

title: Get one run
